As the name suggests, it is crucial to maintain silence during all events. We'll have sufficient amount of breaks when it is ok to make some noise.

Эти соревнования включают в себя только дисциплины, на которых необходимо соблюдать тишину - 3х3х3 вслепую, 4х4х4 вслепую, 5х5х5 вслепую, 3х3х3 Мультиблайнд и 3х3х3 на количество ходов. ![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsibWVzc2FnZSI6IkJBaHBBcElrIiwiZXhwIjpudWxsLCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--4be3c11536038145829dbcba17ca15bdea04981e/imagen.png)
# 🇺🇾
Hay un límite de 10 competidores para el registro.

* Leer el [Reglamento de la WCA](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/) para evitar posibles inconvenientes.
* Esta competencia está abierta a competidores de cualquier nacionalidad, cualquier edad y a nuevos competidores, sin importar sus tiempos de resolución.
* **COMPETIDORES NUEVOS**: deben leer [Importante](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/ItsBLDTimeOpen2023#28208-importante-read) y [Competidores nuevos](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/ItsBLDTimeOpen2023#28209-competidores-nuevos-newcomers).
* Se debe tener en cuenta que los competidores pueden ser descalificados en los casos que prevé el Reglamento de la WCA. No se realizan reembolsos de ningún tipo por descalificación, según el artículo [2l1](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/#2l1).
* Los competidores deben llevar sus propios puzzles.
* Los competidores tienen que estar presentes y listos para competir cuando se los llama, de no ser así, se penalizará al competidor con la descalificación del evento (de la ronda, no de toda la competencia), de acuerdo con el artículo [2u](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/#2u) del reglamento.
* Es importante leer toda la información disponible en la página de la competencia.

Ante cualquier duda consultar a los organizadores o a los delegados de la WCA.

# 🇬🇧
Competitor limit: 10.

* Read the [WCA Regulations](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/) to avoid any issue.
* This competition is open to competitors of any nationality or age.
* **NEW COMPETITORS**: You must read [Important](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/ItsBLDTimeOpen2023#28208-importante-read) and [New competitors](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/ItsBLDTimeOpen2023#28209-competidores-nuevos-newcomers).
* Note that competitors may be disqualified under the circumstances described in the WCA Regulations. A disqualified competitor is not eligible for the refund of any expenses due to participating in the competition, as per regulation [2l1](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/#2l1).
* Competitors must bring their own puzzles.
* Competitors must be present and ready to compete when called, otherwise the competitor will be penalized with the disqualification of the event, in accordance with regulation [2u](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/#2u) of the WCA Regulations.
* It is important to read all the information available in the competition website.

Feel free to contact the organizers or the WCA Delegates.

items.information:
# Please Be Quiet!

Most of the events at this competition are blindfolded events, which require significant levels of concentration, focus, and practice. All attendees, including guests, are expected to remain silent during these events while in the competition room. There will be areas outside of the venue room where competitors and guests can talk at a normal volume.

### Note for new competitors:
Although first-timers are welcome to compete if they know how to solve puzzles blindfolded (please note Regulation [2k6](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/#2k6)) and/or Clock, this might not be the best experience for new competitors and their guests.

Also note that due to the venue space, this may not be the best competition for spectators. Please consider registering for another competition if this one isn't for you.

items.name: BF Vienna Day 2023

venue.name: BMME
venue.details: Folgen Sie den Schildern, um den Veranstaltungsort zu betreten. / Follow the signs to enter the venue.

items.information:
##### *English version is below*

#### **Deutsch:**

Wir freuen uns sehr, euch BF Vienna 2023 als ein offizielles WCA Turnier ankündigen zu können. 

Die Speedcubing Competition wird organisiert von Florian Truckenthanner und Simon Praschl und delegiert von Šimon Borovský und Viktor Kalmar. Diesesmal findet das Turnier in den Räumlichkeiten des BMME statt. Die Resultate dieser Competition werden zu den offiziellen WCA World Rankings hinzugefügt.

Jeder ist bei diesem Turnier herzlich willkommen, unabhängig von der Erfahrung, Alter oder sonstigen Fähigkeiten. Manche Events haben ein spezifisches Zeitlimit, damit wir sicherstellen können den ganzen Tag über im Zeitplan zu bleiben. Es dürfen Puzzles jeder Marke verwendet werden solange sie den WCA Richtlinien entsprechen. 

Da dies ein sehr kleines, ruhiges und auch kurzes Turnier wird sind generell keine Gäste erlaubt (da wir auch von der Räumlichkeit begrenzt sind) - falls jedoch ein Teilnehmer einen Gast dabei haben muss, zb. weil du Minderjährig bist und deinen Erziehungsberechtigten dabei haben willst, dann schreibt uns bitte noch vor dem Turnier eine E-mail mit einer Begründung und mit dem Namen des Gastes.

Generell herrscht absolute Ruhe während des Gesamten Turnieres (ausgenommen von den Pausen) da es sich um Blind Events sowohl als auch um Fewest Moves handelt.

Wir freuen uns besonders auf neue Speedcuber aus Österreich!

-----

#### **English:**

We are happy to announce the BF Vienna 2023 as an official WCA Competition. 

The speedcubing competition is organised by Florian Truckenthanner and Simon Praschl and delegated by Šimon Borovský and Viktor Kalmar. The results of the competition will be added to the official WCA World Rankings.

The competition is open to all competitors regardless of experience and skill, but certain event-based time limits will be in place to make sure we can stay on schedule and get through the day on time. No prior experience in WCA competitions is necessary, but competitors must be familiar with the WCA Regulations. Any puzzle brand may be used during the competition, as long as it complies with the WCA regulations.

This competition is going to be quite small, short and especially quiet and because of this no guests will be allowed at this competition (also because it is a small room).
If you have a good reason why a guest should accompany you (e.g.: you are a minor and you want to have your legal guardian with you), then please let us know before the competition via email (include the name of the guest and the reasoning).

It has to be absolutely quiet during the whole competition (except during the breaks) because we have Blind and Fewest Moves events only.

items.information:
Соревнование проводится с благотворительной целью. Все вырученные средства пойдут в помощь сбору средств на лечение 3-летнего ребенка с инвалидностью Рамира Ковалевского, с диагнозом «Спинальная мышечная атрофия 2 типа», который нуждается в  самом дорогостоящем лекарственном препарате в мире, ZOLGENSMA.

Главный спонсор соревнования – компания «Леовит». Соревнование проводится при поддержке школы №157 и общественного фонда «Alem Asar».. 

Смотрите наш аккаунт в Instagram (https://instagram.com/almaty_cubers), чтобы узнавать новости и подробную информацию о соревновании!

Соревнование будет проходить в спортзале школы №157.

Будем рады видеть вас на соревновании! 

Жарыс қайырымдылық мақсатында өткізеді. Жарыстан бүкіл түскен қаражат спиналды бұлшық атрофия диагнозына шалдыққан мүгедекке 3 жасар бала Рамир Ковалевскийге әлемде ең бағалы дәрі «ZOLGENSMA» сатып алу үшін қаржы жинауға және көмектесуге бағыттайды

Жарыстың бас демеушісі – «Леовит» компаниясы. Жарыс мектептiң №157 мен «Alem Asar» қоғамдық қорының көмегiмен өткiзіледi. 

Біздің Instagram аккаунтымыздың парақшасында (https://instagram.com/almaty_cubers) жаңалықтар және жарыс туралы ақпарат көре аласыздар!

Жарыс мектептің №157 спорт залында өткізіледі.

Сіздің жарысқа белсенді ат салысып қатысқаныңызға қуаныштымыз! 


 
The competition is organised for charity. All the proceeds made from the competition will be spent for fundraising for helping 3-years old kid, Ramir Kovalevsky, in his spinal muscular atrophy medical treatment to purchase him the most expensive cure in the world, ZOLGENSMA.

The Leovit company is the main sponsor of the competition. The competition is organised with the help of school #157 and Alem Asar social foundation.

Watch our posts in our Instagram account (https://instagram.com/almaty_cubers) to learn the news and more information about the competition! 

The competition will be set in the sports hall of the school #157.

We will be happy to see you at the competition!

A inscrição é aberta a qualquer pessoa, de qualquer nacionalidade.

Visando ao bom andamento da competição, ao se inscrever em uma categoria, você se compromete também a ajudar como juiz ou embaralhador nessa categoria (conforme previsto nas regras da WCA). Dessa forma, a competição se torna autossustentável, e as atividades são divididas entre todos os participantes, não ficando pesado para apenas alguns. Foram feitos pelo menos dois grupos em cada modalidade. Em um dos grupos você compete e no outro ajuda a embaralhar ou sendo juiz dos competidores.

**ATENÇÃO:** Está é uma competição que não terá o Cubo 3x3x3 como uma de suas modalidades, apenas modalidades conhecidas como side events, portanto, não é uma competição indicada para iniciantes.

---

Registration is open to any person, from any country.

For the competition to run smoothly, by registering for an event, you agree to help as judge, scrambler or runner for this event (as it's said at WCA rules). This way, the competition turns out to be self-supported, and the activities are divided between all competitors, and not charging anyone in excess. Every event will be divided in at least two groups in first round, in a group you'll compete, and in another you'll help as staff.

**ATTENTION:** This competition will not have the 3x3x3 Cube as one of it's events, only the ones known as side events, that said, it is not a competition indicated for beginners

items.name: Please Be Quiet Joburg 2023
items.information:
### This is not a normal competition

We won't be holding any normal events. This competition is focused on blindfolded events, with a single fewest move attempt to keep things interesting.

If you have not competed before, this may not be the best experience for your first competition. Sign up at [CubingZA](https://cubingza.org) to get notifications for other competitions in your province.

**Please be quiet**. These events can require immense focus, so as the name of the competition suggests, competitors and spectators must remain quiet to ensure fair and equal conditions for all competitors. Those who continually make noise will be asked to leave without refund.

### Venue

The venue is in a private venue in Bryanston. Access for all competitors and guests need to be arranged in advance. Failure to do so will result in you or your guests being denied access to the venue.
There is limited parking that needs to be arranged in advance. **All competitors** must please provide the following information:

1. If you will be arriving by car, please provide registration number.
2. If you will be getting a lift with someone, please provide the name of the person you will be getting a lift with.
3. If using an Uber or other transport, please indicate this.

Once you have provided this information, you will be given the exact address.

### Guests

Competitors may bring only one guest due to venue constraints. If a competitor is bringing a guest, then they must provide the full name and surname. 

### About CubingZA

Competitions in South Africa have exploded since the end of COVID, and interest is only getting stronger. [CubingZA](https://cubingza.org) is a volunteer organisation made up of delegates and community members who have come together to try and ensure that we can sustainably run regular competitions all across the country.

If you'd be interested in helping out, please [get in touch](https://cubingza.org/contact). We are particularly looking for help with communications, and graphic design.

items.name: Vardagscubing IV - Gamla Uppsala 2023
items.information:
Varmt välkommen till den fjärde svenska upplagan av Vardagscubing, denna gång i Uppsala! Tävlingen har ett väldigt speciellt upplägg, där varje deltagare har totalt 21 minuter i lösningstid på sig att genomföra alla sina lösningar, och deltagaren får själv välja vilka grenar man vill spendera sin tid på. Notera dock att varje deltagare denna gång **får välja maximalt fem (5) grenar** att tävla i. Tävlingen, som denna gång går på en **tisdag** pågår endast i drygt 3 timmar. 

Läs gärna igenom alla flikar på denna sida (särskilt "Vardagscubing") så du inte missar någon viktig information.

**OBS:** Anmäler du dig till antingen 3x3x3 FMC eller 3x3x3 Multi-Blind så kan du endast tävla i just den grenen och inte tävla i någon annan gren på tävlingen.

--

Welcome to the fourth Swedish edition of Vardagscubing, this time in Uppsala! The competition has a very special format, where each competitor has a total of 21 minutes of solving time to complete all their solves, and the competitor gets to choose which events to spend their time on. Note, however, that each competitor this time **can choose a maximum of five (5) events** to compete in. The competition, which this time takes place on a **Tuesday**, lasts only roughly 3 hours.

Please read through all the tabs on this page (especially "Vardagscubing") so you don't miss any important information.

**N.B.:** If you register for either 3x3x3 FMC or 3x3x3 Multi-Blind, you can only compete in that particular event and not compete in any other event at the competition.

# 🇺🇾
Hay un límite de 35 competidores para el registro.

* Leer el [Reglamento de la WCA](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/) para evitar posibles inconvenientes.
* Esta competencia está abierta a competidores de cualquier nacionalidad, cualquier edad y a nuevos competidores, sin importar sus tiempos de resolución.
* **COMPETIDORES NUEVOS**: deben leer [Importante](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/MontevideoalCubo2023#24769-importante-read) y [Competidores nuevos](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/MontevideoalCubo2023#24770-competidores-nuevos-new-competitors).
* Se debe tener en cuenta que los competidores pueden ser descalificados en los casos que prevé el Reglamento de la WCA. No se realizan reembolsos de ningún tipo por descalificación, según el artículo [2l1](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/#2l1).
* Los competidores deben llevar sus propios puzzles.
* Los competidores tienen que estar presentes y listos para competir cuando se los llama, de no ser así, se penalizará al competidor con la descalificación del evento (de la ronda, no de toda la competencia), de acuerdo con el artículo [2u](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/#2u) del reglamento.
* Es importante leer toda la información disponible en la página de la competencia.

Ante cualquier duda consultar a los organizadores o a los delegados de la WCA.

# 🇬🇧
Competitor limit: 35.

* Read the [WCA Regulations](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/) to avoid any issue.
* This competition is open to competitors of any nationality or age.
* **NEW COMPETITORS**: You must read [Important](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/MontevideoalCubo2023#24769-importante-read) and [New competitors](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/MontevideoalCubo2023#24770-competidores-nuevos-new-competitors).
* Note that competitors may be disqualified under the circumstances described in the WCA Regulations. A disqualified competitor is not eligible for the refund of any expenses due to participating in the competition, as per regulation [2l1](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/#2l1).
* Competitors must bring their own puzzles.
* Competitors must be present and ready to compete when called, otherwise the competitor will be penalized with the disqualification of the event, in accordance with regulation [2u](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/#2u) of the WCA Regulations.
* It is important to read all the information available in the competition website.

Feel free to contact the organizers or the WCA Delegates.

items.name: Vardagscubing III - Ålidenskolan Open B 2023
items.information:
Varmt välkommen till den tredje svenska upplagan av Vardagscubing, i samarbete med Ålidenskolan i Flen! Tävlingen har ett väldigt speciellt upplägg, där varje deltagare har totalt 18 minuter i lösningstid på sig att genomföra alla sina lösningar, och deltagaren får själv välja vilka grenar man vill spendera sin tid på. Tävlingen, som hålls på en **fredag**, pågår endast i 3,5 timmar. 

Läs gärna igenom alla flikar på denna sida (särskilt "Vardagscubing") så du inte missar någon viktig information.

**OBS:** Anmäler du dig till antingen 3x3x3 FMC eller 3x3x3 Multi-Blind så kan du endast tävla i just den grenen och inte tävla i någon annan gren på tävlingen.

**OBS:** Notera att du bara får anmäla dig till (och delta på) en av de två tävlingarna som hålls i Flen denna dag.

--

A warm welcome to the third Swedish edition of Vardagscubing, in collaboration with Ålidenskolan in Flen! The competition has a very special format, where each participant has a total of 18 minutes of solving time to complete all their solves, and the competitor gets to choose which events to spend their time on. The competition, which this time takes place on a **Friday**, lasts only 3,5 hours.

Please read through all the tabs on this page (especially "Vardagscubing") so you don't miss any important information.

**N.B.:** If you register for either 3x3x3 FMC or 3x3x3 Multi-Blind, you can only compete in that particular event and not compete in any other event at the competition.

**N.B:** Note that you may only register for (and participate in) one of the two competitions held in Flen that day.

[FR]

Pensez à consulter les onglets, en particulier celui du [planning](#competition-schedule).
En raison de la situation sanitaire, les conditions d'accès à la compétition peuvent changer au gré des annonces gouvernementales. L'équipe d'organisation vous informera des restrictions en vigueur à chaque changement.

Portez une attention particulière à l'onglet [Santé & Sécurité](#22925-sante-securite-health-safety).

**Les étudiants de l'ÉTS peuvent s'inscrire sans frais**.  Si vous êtes étudiant de l'ÉTS, inscrivez votre courriel finissant par estmtl.net dans la zone des commentaires lorsque vous vous inscrivez puis **ne payez pas les frais d'inscription**.  
**Vous ne pouvez pas vous inscrire à la fois au 5x5 à l'aveugle et au megaminx**. Vous devez choisir au maximum un des deux. Si vous mettez les deux, votre inscription ne sera pas acceptée.

Il n'y aura **aucun remboursement en cas d'annulation** (à cause des frais de transaction). Cependant si vous vous inscrivez et que vous n'êtes finalement pas en mesure de venir, merci de nous en informer afin de donner la place à quelqu'un d'autre. Les personnes inscrites en file d'attente seront remboursées une fois la période d'inscription s'est fermée.

[EN]

Make sure to read the information in the tabs, especially the one with the [schedule](#competition-schedule).
Due to the sanitary situation, the conditions for accessing the competition venue can vary due to the government's announcements. The organization team will inform everybody of the restrictions as they change. 

Take clear note especially of the [Health and Safety Tab](#22925-sante-securite-health-safety).

**ETS students may compete for free**. If you are an ETS student, write your email address ending with etsmtl.net in the registration comments and submit your registration **without paying the registration fee**.
**You may not register for both 5x5 blindfolded and megaminx**. You must choose at most one of the two. If you put both, your registration will not be accepted.

There will be **no refunds in case of cancellation** (due to transaction fees) . However, if you register and you are not able to come, please let us know so we can give the spot to someone else. You will still be refunded if you are still on the waiting list when the the registration period closes.

items.name: Vardagscubing II - Hive A 2022
items.information:
Välkommen till Vardagscubing II - Hive A 2022, som hålls i centrala Stockholm. Detta är din chans att bli av med de extra kalorierna från julmaten de närmasta dagarna innan tävlingen! Alla är varmt välkomna att tävla, men vänligen läs igenom alla flikar på denna sida för att se till att du inte missar någon viktig information om tävlingen.

### Vänligen notera:
* **3x3x3 FMC kan inte kombineras med någon annan gren. 4x4x4 BLD och 5x5x5 BLD kan inte kombineras med 3x3x3 Multi-Blind (och vice versa).**
* **Varje deltagare får ta med högst en gäst till denna tävling. Varje gäst måste betala en inträdesavgift på 30 SEK för att få komma in i lokalen.** Läs "extra registration requirements" för mer information.
* **Lokalen ligger i en kontorsarbetsplats med hög fysisk säkerhet och du kommer inte att kunna komma och gå som du vill.** Du måste antingen anlända till ytterdörren senast fem minuter innan den första grenen ska starta, eller ge dig själv gott om tid innan din första gren för att se till att någon har tid att släppa in dig. Information om telefonnummer till utvalda Hive Streaming-anställda kommer att mailas till dig dagen innan tävlingen, i fall du behöver ringa någon för att släppa in dig på kontoret.
* **Notera att du bara får anmäla dig till (och delta på) en av de två tävlingarna som hålls i Stockholm denna dag.**

---

Welcome to Vardagscubing II - Hive A 2022, held in downtown Stockholm. This is your chance to work off some of those extra calories from the Christmas food of the past few days! Everyone is warmly welcome to compete, but please read through all tabs on this site to make sure you don't miss any important information about the competition.

### Please note: 
* **3x3x3 FMC can not be combined with any other event. 4x4x4 BLD and 5x5x5 BLD can not be combined with 3x3x3 Multi-Blind (and vice versa).**
* **Every competitor can bring at most one guest to this competition. Every attending guest will have to pay an entry fee of 30 SEK to be allowed inside the venue.** Please read the extra registration requirements for more information.
* **The venue is an office workplace with a high level of physical security, and you will not be able to come and go as you please.** You must either arrive at the front door no later than five minutes before the first event is scheduled to start, or give yourself ample time before your first event to make sure that someone can find the time to let you in. Details of contact phone numbers to selected Hive Streaming employees will be emailed to you the day before the competition, in case you need to call someone to let you in to the office.
* **Note that you may only register for (and participate in) one of the two competitions held in Stockholm that day.**

items.name: Please Be Solved Pickering 2022
items.information:
### Blindfolded events only

The only events at this competition are ***blindfolded events***, which require a significant amount of learning, practice and concentration. All attendees, including competitors and guests, are asked to please remain quiet at this competition to allow competitors to concentrate.

### FMC Canada connection

This competition will be held during the morning/early afternoon on the same day as [FMC Canada](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/FMCCanada2022) in the same venue as the Pickering, ON location. You are welcome to register for one or both competitions, but please note that you would need to ***register for FMC Canada separately***.

### Note for new competitors

Although first-timers are welcome to compete if they know how to solve puzzles blindfolded (please note Regulation [2k6](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/#2k6)), this might not be the best experience for new competitors. Please consider registering for [another competition](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions?region=Canada) if this one isn't for you.

items.name: Vardagscubing I - Uppsala 2022
items.information:
Varmt välkommen till den första svenska upplagan av Vardagscubing, denna gång i Uppsala! Tävlingen har ett väldigt speciellt upplägg, där varje deltagare har totalt 20 minuter i lösningstid på sig att genomföra alla sina lösningar, och deltagaren får själv välja vilka grenar man vill spendera sin tid på. Tävlingen, som denna gång går på en **måndag** pågår endast i 4 timmar. 

Läs gärna igenom alla flikar på denna sida (särskilt "Vardagscubing") så du inte missar någon viktig information.

**OBS:** Anmäler du dig till antingen 3x3x3 FMC eller 3x3x3 Multi-Blind så kan du endast tävla i just den grenen och inte tävla i någon annan gren på tävlingen.

--

Welcome to the first Swedish edition of Vardagscubing, this time in Uppsala! The competition has a very special format, where each participant has a total of 20 minutes of solving time to complete all their solves, and the competitor gets to choose which events to spend their time on. The competition, which this time takes place on a **Monday**, lasts only 4 hours.

Please read through all the tabs on this page (especially "Vardagscubing") so you don't miss any important information.

**N.B.:** If you register for either 3x3x3 FMC or 3x3x3 Multi-Blind, you can only compete in that particular event and not compete in any other event at the competition.

items.name: Kewbz UK Championship 2022
items.information:
## Welcome to Kewbz UK Championship 2022!
### This year's UK National Championship


##### Spectators are welcome! Please read the information below, and the information in the [Spectators and Guests](#22468-spectators-and-guests) tab.

If you are a new competitor, please make sure to read all the information in the **FAQ** and the **Important Information** tabs before registering. All competitors should be familiar with the information in these tabs.

**Free T-Shirt:** By registering and attending Kewbz UK Championship 2022, you'll receive a completely free UK Championship t-shirt as a memento! You will receive this on registration at the venue, where you can choose your size.

**Guests:** Guests will **only** be permitted to attend by paying a **£5** fee **at the competition**. Competitors will receive lanyards, and their guests and spectators will receive wristbands, which are to be worn throughout the weekend for security reasons. **This includes parents/guardians of competitors.** The fee must be paid at the competition and cannot be prepaid beforehand. The guest field in the registration form is for informational purposes only, the fee must be paid at the competition.

**Qualification Requirements:** If you do not meet the qualification requirements in an official WCA competition by *17th October 2022*, you will not be eligible to compete in those events. Please see the **Events** tab to see these requirements. Please note that **new competitors can only compete in 3x3, 2x2, Skewb and Pyraminx**.

**Final Round Advancements:** For all events with more than one round we will be taking a minimum number of UK competitors to the final. If necessary, we will increase the size of the final by one competitor at a time until we have enough UK competitors. The requirements are as follows: 2x2, 4x4, 5x5, 6x6, 7x7, 3x3 Blindfolded, 3x3 One-Handed, Clock, Megaminx, Pyraminx, Skewb, Square-1 - 6 UK competitors; 3x3 - 8 UK competitors. 3x3 Multiple Blindfolded has a Top 16 qualification requirement, similarly this must contain at least 6 UK competitors.

**Fewest Moves:** FMC will **not** be held at this competition. To compete for the national champion title for FMC, you must compete at [Kewbz UK Championship FMC 2022](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/KewbzUKChampionshipFMC2022) on 22nd October instead. The winner of the FMC competition will be awarded their prize during the awards at Kewbz UK Championship 2022.

We will be taking videos and photographs of the competition and the environment for our social media pages and website. Media persons will also be in attendance. By attending the competition as a competitor or a guest, you are accepting that you may be filmed or photographed for these purposes.

**Please Note:** As this is the UK National Championship, only competitors who represent the United Kingdom will be eligible for prizes. The competition remains open for all nationalities to compete.

Būs visas oficiālās WCA disciplīnas + iesācēju kauss un 3x3 ar acīm ciet komandu mači, lai piešķirtu sacensībām nelielu odziņu.
Tikai Latvijas pilsoņi varēs saņemt balvas. Neskatoties uz to piedalīties sacensībās var jebkuras valsts pārstāvji.
Šīs būs pirmās sacensībās, kas norisinās Latvijas garākajā pilsētā - Jūrmalā.

---

After almost 3 years the biggest competition in Latvia returns - Latvian Championship: reborn and revamped.
We are having all the official WCA events + beginner's cup and 3x3 team blind to spice thing up.
Only Latvian citizens are elegible for prizes. Nevertheless competition is open to all nationalities.
This will also be the first speedcubing competition held in the longest city in Latvia - Jūrmala.

items.information:
Välkomna till Svenska Mästerskapen 2022! 

Alla är varmt välkomna att delta, oavsett om du löser kuben på 7 sekunder eller 5 minuter. 

Det blir i år en 2,5-dagarstävling med alla WCA-grenar utom en, 3x3x3 FMC. Den Svenska Mästaren i den grenen kommer krönas på den separata tävlingen [Swedish FMC Championship 2022](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/SwedishFMCChampionship2022).

Vi ber er läsa igenom alla flikar på denna sida eftersom de innehåller mycket värdefull information.

Tävlande av alla nationaliteter är välkomna, men bara deltagare som representerar Sverige kan vinna medaljer, priser och titeln Svensk Mästare.

*Notera vänligen också att klockan ställs* ***tillbaka*** *en timme till vintertid i Sverige natten mot söndag den 30:e oktober, vilket betyder en timmes längre sömn!*

-----

Welcome to the Swedish Championship 2022!

Everyone is welcome to participate, whether you solve the cube in 7 seconds or 5 minutes.

This year there will be a 2,5-day competition with all WCA events but one, 3x3x3 FMC. The Swedish Champion in this event will be crowned at the separate competition [Swedish FMC Championship 2022](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/SwedishFMCChampionship2022).

We ask you to read through all the tabs on this page as they contain very valuable information.

Competitors of all nationalities are welcome, but only participants representing Sweden can win medals, prizes and the title of Swedish Champion.

*Please also note that the clock is set* ***back*** *one hour to winter time in Sweden on the night before Sunday October 30th, which means an hour more sleep!*

![](https://i.imgur.com/Upxb5EP.png)

Why SILENCE?

We will be trying our best to provide you all with an ambience of as much as silence and serenity as possible! Irrespective of the events... Yes, Including 3x3 and other NxN events which don't generally demand silence. :)

We aim to experiment and see how much more efficient we'd all be in an ambience more favorable for cubing. With minimal spectator pressure.

We plan have separate rooms for waiting and competing, where the competing area would only have the competitors for the round, scramblers, and judges in it.

We urge all the competitors to strictly adhere to the rules and regulations to contribute to the mission of providing a serene ambience for all the fellow cubers. 
  
If you're participating in a WCA competition for first time, please bring your ID card as well. 
 
If you're participating in a WCA competition for first time or not aware of competition rules, make sure that you attend the tutorial session.

Happy cubing!

The competition is open to all competitors regardless of experience and skill, but certain event-based time limits will be in place so as to make sure we can stay on schedule and get through the days on time. No prior experience in WCA competitions is necessary, but competitors should be familiar with the WCA regulations.

In addition, NZ North Island Championship 2022 is the last regional championship of 2022 in the lead up to Nationals in December.

複数に申込んだ場合は、申込完了日時が最も早いものだけを受理し、その他は無効となります。

新型コロナウイルス感染症 (COVID-19) 対策のため、本大会では会場への入場者数を制限しています。
飛び込みでの競技参加や見学はできません。

会場の広さの都合上、本大会の**見学申請は、競技参加者１名につき同伴者１名**に制限しています。
競技参加者１名につき２名以上の同伴や、その他**一般からの見学申請は受け付けておりません。**

Mistrzostwa Polski w Speedcubingu to najważniejsza impreza sezonu w kalendarzu każdego polskiego speedcubera. Od 2005 roku nieprzerwanie przyciąga najlepszych zawodników, którzy w atmosferze ducha fair play walczą o tytuł mistrza kraju we wszystkich oficjalnych konkurencjach World Cube Association.

Po niezwykle udanej edycji 2021 Mistrzostwa Polski ponownie zostaną przeprowadzone w miejscu wyjątkowym jakim jest Olivia Star! Poraz kolejny rywalizacji na najwyższym poziomie będą towarzyszyły niesamowite widoki 34 piętra Olivia Star - największego wieżowca w północnej Polsce!

---

Polish Speedcubing Championship is the most important event of the year of every Polish speedcuber. Since 2005 it continues to attract best competitors who compete for national titles in all events sanctioned by World Cube Association.

After successful 2021 edition this year's championship will be held in a special place - Olivia Star! Once again competing at the highest level will be accompanied by amazing views from 34th floor of Olivia Star building - highest scyscraper in northern Poland!

# All attendees (competitors + guests) must show valid proof that they satisfy one of the following two requirements in order to be allowed in the venue:

##### -They are fully vaccinated against COVID-19. To clarify, an individual is only considered fully vaccinated if they have received their second dose of a two-dose vaccine (Pfizer or Moderna) or their only dose of a single-dose vaccine (J&J) more than two weeks before the competition. Any dose received after Saturday, June 18th is insufficient for entrance to the competition.
**OR**

items.name: Blind Is Back LA 2022
items.information:
Don your blindfolds and put on a harmonica holder, because **blind is back** in Southern California! Get ready for SoCal's first blindfolded cubing competition since 2018. Blindsolvers of all experience levels are welcome!

Competitors should read the [Competitor Information](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/BlindIsBackLA2022#19453-competitor-information) tab. Spectators may attend for free, but due to room capacity limitations, guests should be kept to a minimum. Since blindsolving requires a high level of concentration, all attendees are required to be silent during blindfolded events. Guests and competitors may socialize freely in Haines Hall Room A28, on the same floor as the competition venue. All attendees are required to read the [COVID-19 Safety](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/BlindIsBackLA2022#19452-covid-19-safety) tab.

Join our [Facebook group](https://www.facebook.com/groups/SoCalCubing) to hear about competitions in Southern California before registration opens and keep in touch with cubers in the area!

venue.address: 7 Paru Paru Road, Nelson 7010, New Zealand

items.information:
NZ South Island Championship 2022 is an official World Cube Association (WCA) sanctioned speedcubing competition. Speedcubing is solving the 3x3x3 Cube or other similar puzzles as quickly as possible. The competition is open to all competitors regardless of experience and skill, but certain event-based time limits will be in place so as to make sure we can stay on schedule and get through the days on time. No prior experience in WCA competitions is necessary, but competitors should be familiar with the WCA regulations.

In addition, NZ South Island Championship 2022 is the first regional championship of 2022 in the lead up to Nationals later in 2022.

items.name: Oslo Open 2022
items.information:
## Informasjon

Norsk:

Velkommen til Oslo Open 2022! Dette er den første kube konkuransen i Oslo siden 2015! Vi gleder oss!
Du melder deg på konkurransen online. Hvis du ikke har en WCA konto må du først lage en [her](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/users/sign_up). 

Påmeldingen åpner lørdag 28. mai kl 16:00 norsk tid.
Det koster 150 NOK å delta. 
Prisen inkluderer et måltid med mat og drikke på lørdag. 
Det er kort vei til matbutikker og take away tilbud i nærområdet.

Vi følger lokale koronarestriksjoner. Pr dd er det ingen særlige krav eller restriksjoner i Oslo.

## Information

English:

Welcome to Oslo Open 2022! This is the first cube competition in Oslo since 2015!
You can register for the competition online. If you don’t have a WCA account you can make one [here](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/users/sign_up).

The registration opens Saturday 28 of May at 6:00 PM Norwegian time.

We follow local Covid restrictions. As of today, there are no special requirements or restrictions in Oslo.

items.name: UBC Side Events 2022
items.information:
* **Regular 3x3 will not be held at this competition**.
* If you are **not** competing in 3x3x3 Multi-Blind in the morning then you do **not** need to show up until after lunch (but coming anyway to help out would be appreciated).
* All competitors will be **expected to help out** in order for the event to run smoothly.
* Cutoffs, advancement conditions, and event start times may change depending on registration totals - any changes will be emailed out to registered competitors in advance.

###As per UBC's rules, masks will be required at this competition. 

However, due to the recent changes to BC Public Health Order, we will not be seeking the proof of vaccination status of competitors and guests. As an expected and still valuable courtesy, we simply ask that those experiencing any COVID-19 like symptoms or those with a recent positive COVID-19 test refrain from attending. Competitors may arrange with the organisational team for a full refund if they need to opt out due to the onset of illness or a positive test. Naturally we have a COVID-19 Information tab here on the website to share any useful considerations pertaining to personal wellness at the competition and as a place to communicate any additional changes to the new health order - if the government re-introduces restrictions such as proof of vaccination, we will update the website and email registered competitiors.

Registration with a $22 CDN payment through Stripe opens Friday May 13th 5:00pm PDT.

Note that registration will close two weeks later. No on the spot registrations will be accepted.
Registration is first come, first served based on the order of when payment through Stripe is received.
A waitlist will be maintained for those unable to secure a spot in the competition.

BY REGISTERING, YOU AGREE THAT YOU UNDERSTAND AND WILL FOLLOW ALL OF THE HEALTH AND SAFETY MEASURES LISTED IN THE HEALTH AND SAFETY (COVID) TAB AND ACCEPT THAT ANY OF THE MEASURES MAY NEED TO BE CHANGED CLOSER TO THE DATE OF THE COMPETITION.

Spectators can attend for free. Being mindful of space, we require that each competitor bring at most 1 guest.

items.information:
### General Information

This competition will take place as part of the Arnold Classic Sport Festival. Please note that due to the nature of the festival the venue will be extremely noisy, and this is outside of our control. The competition will be taking place in a large tent, and it is June, so dress warmly.

### Competitor Tickets

Please register for the competition and select your events [here](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/ArnoldClassicAfrica2022/register), and then pay for your registration at:
https://www.quicket.co.za/events/175059-speed-cubing-arnold-classic-africa/#/
Tickets for competitors cost R200, which includes access to the rest of the expo and sport festival.


### Guests

Spectators are welcome, but will need to pay for entrance to the expo. Tickets can be bought online through [WebTickets](https://www.webtickets.co.za/v2/EventCategories.aspx?itemid=1513459420) or paid for at the door. Various pricing options are available depending on whether you wish to attend for the whole weekend or just one day.
**[Tickets for guests](https://www.webtickets.co.za/v2/EventCategories.aspx?itemid=1513459420)**

### Volunteering

We will require volunteers to support with running and judging on the day. If you would like to volunteer to help staff at the competition, please contact the organisers. Groups will be assigned so that volunteer duties don't clash with your competing.

items.name: Hive Blind 2022
items.information:
Välkommen till Hive Blind 2022, som hålls i centrala Stockholm. Detta är en sista chans att kvalificera sig inför [Rubik's WCA European Championship 2022](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/Euro2022) i juli. Alla är varmt välkomna att tävla, men kom ihåg att denna tävling endast håller utvalda sido- och blindgrenar. Vänligen läs igenom alla flikar på denna sida för att se till att du inte missar någon viktig information om tävlingen.

### Vänligen notera:
* **Vi förväntar oss en mycket hög efterfrågan jämfört med antalet tillgängliga deltagarplatser för den här tävlingen, så om du vill ha en plats måste du antagligen anmäla dig direkt när registreringen öppnar.** Anmälan öppnar tisdagen den 26:e april, klockan 20:00 svensk tid.
* **Varje deltagare får ta med högst en gäst till denna tävling. Varje gäst måste betala en inträdesavgift på 20 SEK för att få komma in i lokalen.** Läs "extra registration requirements" för mer information.
* **Lokalen ligger i matsalen på en kontorsarbetsplats med hög fysisk säkerhet och du kommer inte att kunna komma och gå som du vill.** Du måste antingen anlända till ytterdörren senast fem minuter innan den första grenen ska starta, eller ge dig själv gott om tid innan din första gren för att se till att någon har tid att släppa in dig. Information om telefonnummer till utvalda Hive Streaming-anställda kommer att mailas till dig dagen innan tävlingen, i fall du behöver ringa någon för att släppa in dig på kontoret.

---

Welcome to Hive Blind 2022, held in downtown Stockholm. This is a last-chance-to qualify competition before the [Rubik's WCA European Championship 2022](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/Euro2022) in July. Everyone is warmly welcome to compete, but remember that this competition only holds selected side and blind events. Please read through all tabs on this site to make sure you don't miss any important information about the competition.

### Please note: 
* **We expect very high demand compared to available spots for this competition, so if you want a spot, you will likely need to register the very second when registration opens.** Registration opens on Tuesday 26th April, at 20:00 Swedish time.
* **Every competitor can bring at most one guest to this competition. Every attending guest will have to pay an entry fee of 20 SEK to be allowed inside the venue.** Please read the extra registration requirements for more information.
* **The venue is located in the canteen of an office workplace with a high level of physical security, and you will not be able to come and go as you please.** You must either arrive at the front door no later than five minutes before the first event is scheduled to start, or give yourself ample time before your first event to make sure that someone can find the time to let you in. Details of contact phone numbers to selected Hive Streaming employees will be emailed to you the day before the competition, in case you need to call someone to let you in to the office.

If you would like to be on the competitor list, please carefully note exactly when registration opens, and sign up as soon as possible. This competition has filled up very quickly in the past, so do not miss out. Please see other tabs for more information.

**MINORS POLICY:** Princeton University now requires chaperones for all minors participating in on-campus events. Therefore, any child under 18 that plans to compete must be accompanied by a parent or other adult, who will be required to sign in. (Please reach out to the organizer with any issues/questions.)

**COVID POLICY:** Princeton University is requiring that all visitors attest to being fully immunized against COVID-19. You are considered fully immunized after **both** of the below conditions are met:
* At least 2 weeks after your second dose in a 2-dose series, such as the Pfizer or Moderna vaccines, or 2 weeks after a single-dose vaccine, such as Johnson & Johnson.
* Received booster if more than 6 months since the second dose of a two-dose series or if more than 2 months since a single dose of J&J.
Individuals who are not fully immunized may not enter campus buildings.

The organizers also request that competitors and guests wear a mask for the duration of the competition.

**GUEST POLICY:** Each competitor is allowed to bring only 1 guest. If you would like to bring additional guests, please reach out to the organizers and we will let you know if there are any extra guest slots - we are limiting the venue to holding 150 people total.

items.information:
#### Svenska
# Denna tävling har ställts in på grund av förändrade COVID-19 restriktioner.

Välkomna till Uppsala Open 2022, en mysig endagstävling i Stenhagen, Uppsala. Det här är första gången en tävling hålls i Uppsala på 7 år! 
Glöm inte att läsa igenom alla flikar för viktig information gällande tävlingen.
*Du får välja mellan att delta i antingen 6x6/7x7, eller 4bld/5bld. 4bld och 5bld kommer hållas på "Side stage", samtidigt som 6x6 och 7x7.*

**På grund av regeringens nya restriktioner så kommer alla vuxna deltagare och gäster över 18 år behöva visa Covidbevis (vaccinationsbevis) för att få vistas i lokalen. Mer information om detta finns under fliken "COVID-19.**


#### English
# This competition has been cancelled due to a change in COVID-19 restrictions.

Welcome to Uppsala Open 2022, a cozy one day competition in Stenhagen, Uppsala. This is the first time a competition is held in Uppsala in 7 years!
Do not forget to read all of the tabs for important information regarding the competition.
*You may choose to compete either in 6x6/7x7, or 4bld/5bld. 4bld and 5bld will be held at the side stage, at the same time as 6x6 and 7x7.*

**Due to the Swedish government's new restrictions, all adult competitors and guests over the age of 18 will need to show a vaccination certificate to be allowed to be present at the venue. More information on this can be found under the tab "COVID-19.**

items.name: Wellington Mind Games 2022

venue.name: [ASB Sports Centre](http://wellington.govt.nz/recreation/get-active-indoors/asb-sports-centre)
venue.address: 72 Kemp St, Kilbirnie, Wellington 6022, New Zealand

items.information:
Wellington Mind Games 2021 is an official World Cube Association (WCA) sanctioned speedcubing competition. It is focused on some of the more mentally demanding events, that are given less of a focus in normal competitions - blindfolded and fewest moves solving, specifically.

The competition is open to all competitors regardless of experience or skill. There will also be event-based time limits in place, to ensure we stay on schedule, especially given the time taken by fewest moves solving. No prior experience in WCA competitions is necessary, but competitors should be familiar with the WCA regulations.

**The main event of this competition is Fewest Moves**

items.name: Norrkubing 2021
items.information:
This is the 2021 edition of Norrkubing. A competition which history started in 2015, and this is the 6th time a competition has been organized in this municipality. The competition is open to everyone but limited to 25 competitors due to regulations regarding covid-19.

Please read through all the tabs on this site carefully, as they contain very useful about the competition. This includes especially the COVID-19 tab, with the measures in place to limit the spread of the virus at the competition. Note that members of SveKub have a 25% discount on the registration fee. The membership is free, although a Swedish personal number is needed, more information can be found on the SveKub website.

Lastly, we would like to remind you that the COVID-19 situation is very uncertain, and that late changes including a cancellation of the competition on short notice can't be ruled out. Therefore, please keep an eye on this website and your email to receive the latest information, and keep in mind that the organizers will only be able to refund the registration fee, not personal travel expenses.

-----

Detta är 2021 års upplaga av Norrkubing. Tävlingen arrangerades för första gången år 2015, och detta är den sjätte gången en tävling arrangeras i denna kommun. Tävlingen är öppen för alla men begränsad till maximalt 25 deltagare på grund av restriktioner kring covid-19.

Läs igenom alla flikar på denna sida noga, då de innehåller mycket värdefull information om tävlingen. Detta gäller särskilt fliken COVID-19, med de smittoskyddsåtgärder som kommer gälla under tävlingen. Notera även att medlemmar i SveKub har 25% rabatt på anmälningsavgiften. Att bli medlem är gratis, mer information finns på Svekubs hemsida.

Slutligen vill vi påminna om att COVID-19 situationen är mycket osäker, och att sena förändringar inklusive att tävlingen ställs in med kort varsel tyvärr inte går att utesluta. Håll därför nära koll på denna hemsida samt er email för att få den senaste informationen och kom ihåg att arrangörerna endast kan återbetala anmälningsavgiften, inte personliga reseutgifter.

Registration will happen on this WCA-page and is not considered complete before we have received the payment of the entry fee which has been set to 200 SEK. For more information about this competition, see the tabs.

-----

#Tävlingen har ställts in på grund av ökat antal rapporterade fall av COVID-19 i Sverige.#

Detta är 2020 års upplaga av Norrkubing. Tävlingen arrangerades för första gången år 2015, och detta är den sjätte gången en tävling arrangeras i denna kommun.

Tävlingen är öppen för alla men begränsad till maximalt 25 deltagare på grund av restriktioner kring covid-19. Besökare är varmt välkomna under tävlingen, men varje deltagare får ta med sig maximalt en gäst. Registreringen kommer att ske på denna WCA-sida och anses inte vara färdig innan vi mottagit betalningen av anmälningsavgiften som har fastställts till 200 SEK. För mer information om tävlingen, se flikarna ovan.

venue.address: Le Corum, Esplanade Charles de Gaulle, Montpellier
venue.details: Toit du Corum (voir plans dans les onglets / see plans in the tabs)

items.information:
Ceci est la 184ème competition sur le sol Français, autant de compétitions auquelles a participé François Courtès, décédé en 2016. Il a grandi à Montpellier.
Cette compétition sera un hommage en son honneur.

**Hommage :** si vous souhaitez faire un discours ou partager des photos (même si vous n'êtes pas présents à la compétition), contactez [Clément Cherblanc](mailto:ccherblanc@worldcubeassociation.org).

Pensez à consulter les onglets, en particulier celui du [planning](#competition-schedule) et du [plan d'accès](#13873-comment-y-acceder-how-to-access). Merci également de **lire attentivement les conditions d'inscription**.

L'épreuve principale de cette compétition est le 3x3 à l'aveugle.

----
This is the 184th competition in France, as many competitions as François Courtès attended, before he died in 2016. He grew up in Montpellier.
This competition is a tribute in his honor.

**Memorial:** if you would like to make a speech or share photos (even if you are not attending the competition), please contact [Clément Cherblanc](mailto:ccherblanc@worldcubeassociation.org).

Make sure to read the information in the tabs, especially the one with the [schedule](#competition-schedule) and [access plan](#13873-comment-y-acceder-how-to-access). Also, **please read the registration requirements carefully**.

The main event of the competition is 3x3x3 Blindfolded.

This competition holds only "Please Be Quiet" events - 3x3x3 Blindfolded, 4x4x4 Blindfolded, 5x5x5 Blindfolded, 3x3x3 Multiblind and 3x3x3 Fewest Moves Challenge. As the name suggests, it is crucial to maintain silence during all events. We'll have sufficient amount of breaks when it is ok to make some noise.

Эти соревнования включают в себя только дисциплины, на которых необходимо соблюдать тишину - 3х3х3 вслепую, 4х4х4 вслепую, 5х5х5 вслепую, 3х3х3 Мультиблайнд и 3х3х3 на количество ходов. Как следует из названия, чрезвычайно важно сохранять полную тишину во время всех дисциплин. У нас будет достаточное количество перерывов, во время которых можно будет пошуметь.

items.information:
Vous n'êtes pas obligé d'arriver au moment de l'enregistrement, nous vous accepterons sans aucun problème si vous arrivez dans la journée. Essayez simplement d'être là au moins 30 minutes avant votre première épreuve.
Une pièce d'identité vous sera demandée si c'est votre première compétition.
**Merci de nous prévenir par e-mail si finalement vous ne pouvez pas participer à la compétition.**

**REPAS** :
Les samedi soir et dimanche soir, nous vous proposons un repas collectif et des jeux, sur le lieu de la compétition.
Samedi soir, pour 10€ : 
* Des diots (saucisse de porc Savoyarde) et des crozets (une alternative végétarienne/végétalienne devrait être disponible, merci de nous le préciser)
* Un dessert, incluant des gourdes de compote de pomme ou des fruits, un yaourt et peut-être un gateau

Dimanche soir pour 15€ : 
* Une grande pizza (au choix, commande le jour J)
* Un dessert, comme le samedi

**LASER GAME** :
Le samedi soir, nous allons au Laser Game ensemble, nous arrangerons les voitures avec les personnes présentes. Nous avons la grande salle, de 21h50 à minuit pour 2 parties de 45 minutes. Vous pouvez participer aux deux pour 28€ (à régler au Laser Game) ou une pour 15€.
Merci de préciser dans la section "Commentaire" de votre inscription si vous comptez venir, et si vous êtes accompagnés, car il y a un nombre limité de places ! 

---
You are not obliged to be here at registration time, we will accept you if you come during the day. Try to be here at least 30 minutes before your first event.
We'll ask for an ID if it's your first competition.
**Please send us an email if you cannot participate after all.**

**DINNERS**:
On Saturday and Sunday evening, we propose a dinner all together, and games, at the competition venue.
Saturday evening for 10€:
* "Diots" (Savoyarde pork saussage) et "crozets" (a bit like pasta) (a vegetarian/vegan alternative should be availble, please ask us)
* A dessert, including an apple jam or fruits, a yogurt and maybe a cake

Sunday evening for 15€:
* A big pizza (to be chosen on the day)
* A dessert, like on Saturday

**LASER GAME**:
On saturday night we will go to play Laser Game together, we'll arrange shuttles with the cars available. We will have the main room from 21h50 to midnight for two 45 minute games. You can play in both for 28€ (to pay at the Laser Game) or one for 15€.
Please mention in the "Comment" section of your registration to the competition if you're coming and if you are alone or with guests. There are limited spots!

This will be the second Copper Country Cubing (Michigan Technological University) competition, in Michigan's great Upper Peninsula. 

The Memorial Union Building (MUB) is located between the middle and west end of the Michigan Tech campus. Check the schedule to see if the events at that time will be in the second floor ballroom, first floor alumni lounge, or ground floor commons.

We are excited to be bringing all 18 official WCA events to the area, which doesn't get many competitions. The first CCC competition had only 8 events and 23 competitors, so this time we're making it bigger and better! Friday is reserved for big BLD and feet, so you can arrive just for Saturday and Sunday if you aren't interested in that subset of events.

items.name: UK Championship 2019
items.information:
Please make sure to read all the information in the tabs above.

**Qualification Requirements**: If you do not meet the qualification requirements in competition *before* 11 October 2019, you will not be eligible to compete in those events. Please see the [Qualification tab](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/UKChampionship2019#9139-qualification) to see all times required.

**Final Round Advancements**: For all events with more than one round we will be taking a minimum number of UK competitors to the final. If necessary, we will increase the size of the final by one competitor at a time until we have enough UK competitors. The requirements are as follows: 3x3x3 with Feet - 4 UK competitors; 2x2x2 Cube, 4x4x4 Cube, 5x5x5 Cube, 6x6x6 Cube, 7x7x7 Cube, 3x3x3 Blindfolded, 3x3x3 One-Handed, Clock, Megaminx, Pyraminx, Skewb, Square-1 - 6 UK competitors; 3x3x3 Cube - 8 UK competitors.

items.information:
(HR)

Croatian Nationals 2019 je trinaesto natjecanje po redu koje se održava u Hrvatskoj od 2011. godine. Bilo tko može sudjelovati, bez obzira na nacionalnost i starost, no svatko mora biti upoznat s WCA Pravilnikom.

Natjecanje je pod organizacijom Udruge Speedcubing Hrvatska. Kotizacija pokriva trošak organizacije i najma prostora. Mogući višak kotizacije ide u svrhu razvitka Udruge Speedcubing Hrvatska. Članovi Udruge Speedcubing Hrvatska ostvaruju 25% popusta na kotizaciju. Također, natjecanje je priznato kao Nacionalno Prvenstvo te će se dijeliti nagrade za najbolja 3 Hrvata u svim disciplinama. 

--------------

(EN)

Croatian Nationals 2019 is the 13th speedcubing competition being held in Croatia since 2011. Anyone can participate, no matter which nationality or age they are, but they need to be familiar with the WCA Regulations.

This competition is being organized by the Speedcubing Association Croatia. Registration fee covers the cost of the organization and venue rental. Any extra money goes directly to support Speedcubing Association Croatia.  Members of Speedcubing Association Croatia have 25% discount on the registration fee. This competition is also recognized as Croatian National Championship and top 3 Croatians in all events will be additionally awarded, alongside regular podiums.

venue.name: [Wellington College](https://www.wellington-college.school.nz/facility-hire)
venue.address: 15 Dufferin St, Mount Victoria, Wellington 6021, New Zealand

items.information:
Following the first competition in Oceania (New Zealand Championships 2009), speedcubing exploded in popularity across the continent. Now, ten years later, we're holding a competition to celebrate the growth of the community, and everything we've achieved over that period. Oceania 10th Anniversary 2019 returns to Wellington, the site of that first competition, and marks almost exactly ten years since then.
Additionally, this is the first competition of the "Cubing Down Under Tour" - a tightly scheduled series of competitions across Oceania, leading up to WCA World Championship 2019, in Melbourne. This should build hype for the World Championship, and, (especially for foreign competitors) provide an excellent opportunity to experience more of the continent. For more information, visit the [travel page](https://wc2019.speedcubing.org.au/en/travel) of the World Championship website.

======================================================
После оплаты взноса ваша фамилия появится на сайте. Это означает что ваша заявка принята. Если вы не оплатили взнос, то примерно за 1-2 недели до соревнований вы получите письмо с напоминанием о необходимости оплатить взнос для подтверждения своего участия. Обязательно проверяйте свой ящик и спам. Если вы не оплатите взнос, то Ваша заявка не будет принята. **ATTENTION!!!
1. If a participant under 18 years old attends the competition without adult, he must have written application from parents or legal guardians that they are responsible for their child.
2. Puzzles used in competitions must have distinctive marks by which the owner can easily identify them (for example, scratched initials or the name on the inside of the removable cover)
**

After paying the fee, your name will appear on the site. This means that your application has been accepted.
If you did not pay the fee, then approximately 1-2 weeks before the competition you will receive an email with
a reminder to pay a fee to confirm your participation.
Be sure to check your box and spam. If you do not pay the fee, your application will not be
accepted. If you submitted an application and paid the fee, but it was not confirmed within 2 business days, contact the organizers immediately (not counting the weekend).

Registration Fee:
There is a **$20** registration fee for the event, payable through the WCA Stripe payment system. Please note that even after payment, registrations need to be manually approved before appearing on the registration list, so you may still not be fully confirmed immediately after payment. Please keep an eye out for the e-mail saying you have been approved. Registration is on a first-come first-serve and the same will go for the waitlist once registration fills up. items.name: Heimaey Open 2018
items.information:
This competition will take place on the 6th of June and it is the first competition ever in Heimaey!
To get to the island you need to go with a ferry called Herjólfur. The harbor is called Landeyjahöfn and is ~2 hours away from Reykjavík. It is possible to take a bus from there. You can order tickets to the ferry here - https://www.seatours.is/ .
You can check out booking.com or airbnb.com for information about hotels and other places to stay in over night.
Our goal with the schedule is to have events that were not held at Icelandic nationals.

----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

Þetta mót verður haldið 6. júni og er það fyrsta mótið á Heimaey frá upphafi!

Hér getur þú pantað miða í Herjólf - https://www.saeferdir.is/ferdir-i-bodi/vestmannaeyjar/
Þú getur kíkt á booking.com / airbnb.com fyrir upplýsingar um hótel eða aðra gistingu í Vestmannaeyjum.

items.information: SNZ Southern 2018 is an official World Cube Association (WCA) sanctioned speedcubing competition. Speedcubing is solving the Rubik's Cube or other similar puzzles as quickly as possible. The competition is open to all competitors regardless of experience and skill, but certain event-based time limits will be in place so as to make sure we can stay on schedule and get through the day on time. No prior experience in WCA competitions is necessary, but competitors should be familiar with the WCA regulations.
